title: Priority Heatmap — deployment slices (WIP)
content:
Purpose:
This is a working heatmap-style prioritization sheet for upcoming QBRs and renewal outreach. Goal: produce a ranked playbook view that combines account tier, ICP alignment, deployment mode (hosted / dedicated / private), region, and health signals into a single visual/prioritization output.

Quick summary of approach:
- Score each account on four axes: Business Impact (tier/spend), ICP fit, Deployment Risk (private/dedicated > hosted), and Health Signals (usage, errors, latency, support tickets).
- Apply weights (example below) to compute a composite priority score and place accounts into a 3x3 heatmap bucket: High/Medium/Low priority across "Strategic" vs "Transactional" dimensions.
- Split views by deployment mode slice so CS leads can route action to the right owner (platform PS, solutions eng, renewals AE).

Scoring rubric (suggested, adjustable):
- Business Impact (weight 35%): Tier A=100, B=60, C=20. Consider ARR, growth rate, strategic reference potential.
- ICP Fit (weight 25%): 0-100: 100 = perfect ICP + product-market fit; 50 = partial; 10 = poor fit.
- Deployment Risk (weight 20%): Private/on-prem=100 (highest risk), Dedicated=70, Hosted=20. Add +20 if region is constrained (no local region).
- Health Signals (weight 20%): Usage trend +30, sustained errors or latency +40, open critical tickets +30, renewal sentiment -20. Normalize to 0-100.

Composite score = round( BusinessImpact*0.35 + ICP*0.25 + DeployRisk*0.2 + Health*0.2 )
Buckets (for heatmap):
- 80-100: Priority-1 (Immediate outreach, exec sponsor)
- 60-79: Priority-2 (Coordinate technical remediation + renewal ops)
- 0-59: Priority-3 (standard renewal cadence)

Deployment-slice routing examples:
- Hosted, Priority-1: Owner = CSM + Renewals AE; play = contract adjust, pricing review, upsell motion.
- Dedicated, Priority-1: Owner = CSM + Solutions Eng + Infra Partner; play = capacity commit review, latency deep-dive, SLA paperwork.
- Private/on-prem, Priority-1: Owner = CSM + PS + Security Lead; play = audit log review, KMS/HSM plan, air-gap checklist.

Example rows (textual, to be converted to sheet columns):
- Acme Analytics | Tier A | ICP: 90 | Deploy: Dedicated | Region: EMEA | Usage: +12% | Errors: sporadic | Open tickets: 1 P2 | Composite: 83 | Bucket: P1 | Action: Schedule infra design + renewal sync wk of Mar 15
- Meridian Retail | Tier B | ICP: 70 | Deploy: Hosted | Region: NA | Usage: flat | Errors: none | Open tickets: 0 | Composite: 64 | Bucket: P2 | Action: Playbook: value recap + renewal email + 1:1 with AE
- AtlasBank (regulated) | Tier A | ICP: 95 | Deploy: Private | Region: APAC | Usage: high | Errors: latency 95th% spikes | Open tickets: 3 P1 | Composite: 92 | Bucket: P1 | Action: Exec brief + security review + dedicated SRE runbook

Meeting agenda for prioritization sync (30–40 min):
1) 5 min: quick review of scoring changes since last snapshot (Priya)
2) 10 min: highlight P1 accounts by deployment slice (owners callouts)
3) 10 min: blockers and PS/SE capacity needs (Solutions Eng)
4) 5–10 min: decide next outreach timeline and owners (Renewals + Sales Ops)

Deliverables / next steps:
- Convert this doc to a Google Sheet view with columns: account, ARR, tier, ICP_score, deploy_mode, region, usage_trend, error_score, open_tickets, health_score, composite_score, bucket, action_owner, due_date. (Owner: Lucas Meyer — due 2026-03-17)
- Build a dashboard card in Console to surface top 20 Priority accounts by composite score (owner: Ruth Chen; link to dashboard in linked_artifacts).
- Run a 1:1 calibration session with AE leads to validate Tier mappings for accounts > $250k ARR (Priya + Diego — by 2026-03-22).

Open questions / TODOs:
- Agree final weighting. Proposal above is starting point; prefer to lock weights before we automate.
- How do we fold in qualitative renewal sentiment from AE notes? Proposed: +/− up to 15 points to Health Signals after manual review.
- Confirm list of 'regions with limited capacity' for deployment risk modifier (infra to supply).

Notes to self (quick):
- Keep heatmap view exportable into slide for Exec QBRs.
- Flag accounts with upcoming feature-deprecation exposure and add "tech-risk" tag in sheet.

If you are reviewing: please add comments inline with suggested weight changes, and flag accounts you think should move buckets before the sync.

Version history (WIP):
